description.value: Roseland Restaurant has been a fixture of the Abbotsford community since 1990, serving a broad menu of Western-style breakfast, lunch, and dinner in a cozy, flower-decorated dining room with a mini lounge and leather booth seating. The restaurant operates as a full-service restaurant and bar and accommodates groups and large parties. Pickup and delivery options are available alongside the sit-down experience.

address.value: 33550 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2S 5G7

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: bollard (9 spaces) at 77m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number and street address. However, the OSM 'community' field says Chilliwack while the website explicitly states 'serving abbotsford community since 1990' and the contact page lists 'Abbotsford, BC' — postal code V2S 5G7 is also an Abbotsford code, confirming this is an Abbotsford restaurant. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; takeout (pickup) and vegan options are confirmed from website text.
concerns: OSM 'community' tag and the broader OSM record associates this listing with Chilliwack, but the website explicitly identifies the business as serving the Abbotsford community, the contact page lists 'Abbotsford, BC', and postal code V2S 5G7 is an Abbotsford code — the OSM community assignment appears to be incorrect.
OSM opening hours differ slightly from website contact page hours (OSM: Mo-Sa 07:00-21:00 / Su 07:00-20:00; website: Mon–Sat 8:00am–9:00pm / Sun & Holidays 8:00am–8:00pm).
Website copyright footer reads '© 2015' suggesting the site has not been updated in many years, though phone number and address appear consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Roseland is a well-established, active full-service restaurant suitable for touring cyclists, but all three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are unverified from available evidence and require on-the-ground or direct confirmation before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated 'VEGAN BREAKFAST' item (Beyond sausages with hashbrowns and fresh fruit cup); website states 'no matter what dietary regiment you follow, we have something for everyone.'
